findings: Inventory gate: do not pin until standalone HBQ-RS contains the Palimpsest-authored six-leaf content-treatment fidelity module and both trees report 278 modules / 2145 leaves / 85 bundles with identical module, leaf, and bundle identities—not merely matching counts.
Delta gate: the only allowed Palimpsest-vs-standalone content gap at freeze is that one additive six-leaf module; any extra path, ID, hash, or bundle-membership drift is a blocker.
Identity gate: upstream must be additive. Leaf/module/bundle IDs and content hashes of the existing 277/2139/85 set must be unchanged so immutable run manifests still verify.

Boundary gate: Palimpsest/Rubric Book becomes an exact SHA gitlink; palimpsest.hbq remains the only Palimpsest facade. App, runtime, and old-project loaders must not import submodule internals or Palimpsest-local copies.
Runtime gate: local-first open, immutable run manifests, and old-project openability are non-negotiable. A clone or install missing the pinned tree must fail closed, never silently empty-book.

Pin gate: the first Palimpsest commit that deletes the vendored Rubric Book and adds the gitlink must record the exact HBQ-RS SHA plus the last Palimpsest-native Rubric Book tree SHA as a rollback snapshot.

Update workflow: freeze Palimpsest-local rubric edits → upstream the six-leaf module → verify identity-equal inventories → tag/SHA-pin that commit → replace Palimpsest/Rubric Book with the submodule → keep palimpsest.hbq as facade → re-run old-project open, manifest replay, and offline/local-first fixtures → thereafter Palimpsest rubric changes only via standalone commit + explicit pin-bump PR.
Post-cutover rule: never track a branch; never commit submodule working-tree edits inside Palimpsest; pin bumps are Palimpsest releases that re-validate manifests and old projects.
recommendations: Treat inventory equality as a content-identity check (IDs, hashes, bundle membership), not a headline count check of 278/2145/85.
Upstream the six-leaf module first; pin only at the SHA that already contains it so Palimpsest does not drop authored fidelity content.
Archive the last Palimpsest-native Rubric Book tree before converting the path to a gitlink so rollback can restore files, not an empty directory.
Keep palimpsest.hbq as the stable facade and freeze all other Palimpsest imports away from Rubric Book paths across the cutover.
Encode clone, CI, and release packaging so the pinned tree is always present; local-first must not depend on a live network fetch at project open.
Make pin bumps explicit Palimpsest PRs with fixture replay (old projects, immutable manifests, offline open); reject floating submodule tracking.
After freeze, route all rubric changes through standalone HBQ-RS, then bump the pin—no dual-write window.
risks: Pinning current standalone (277/2139/85) before upstream drops the six-leaf module and breaks Palimpsest content-treatment fidelity and any manifests that reference those leaves.
Count coincidence on 85 bundles can hide leaf-level or membership drift; old manifests then fail after a ‘successful’ pin.
Rewriting IDs or hashes during upstream silently invalidates immutable run manifests even if inventories look equal.
Git submodule checkout is not local-first: clone without init/update, sparse CI, or an installer that omits gitlinks yields an empty Rubric Book while Palimpsest still opens.
Deleting the vendored tree without a snapshot makes rollback restore a gitlink, not the previous files; history surgery will not reopen old projects.
Path and load-order shifts under Palimpsest/Rubric Book break old-project openability if loaders still expect Palimpsest-native files.
Unpinned or dirty submodule state lets Palimpsest authors edit HBQ-RS in-tree and create unreproducible pins.
Facade leakage (direct Rubric Book imports) couples Palimpsest to submodule layout and makes the next pin a breaking change.
output.summary: Exact-pin Palimpsest/Rubric Book to standalone HBQ-RS only after the six-leaf content-treatment fidelity module is upstreamed and both inventories are identity-equal at 278/2145/85. Keep palimpsest.hbq, local-first runtime, immutable manifests, and old-project openability unchanged. Freeze local rubric edits, pin a SHA not a branch, snapshot the last Palimpsest-native tree before the gitlink swap, and treat later pin bumps as Palimpsest releases. Main traps are pinning too early, count-only equality, missing submodule content at open, and rollback that restores a gitlink instead of files.
